fields.headline: FOURBALLS.
fields.body: 2 against 2, 4 balls in play, and the session to open a Cup with when half the field has not met the other half.

fields.headline:
ONE BAD HOLE
COSTS NOTHING.
fields.body: Everyone plays their own ball. The better net score on each side counts on the hole, so a player in the trees costs their side nothing while their partner's ball is in.

fields.headline: 90% EACH.
fields.body: The WHS allowance, which the app defaults to, then shots off the lowest in the match. A society that has always played 100% changes it on the session.

fields.headline:
NET, OR
POINTS.
fields.body: Every player's gross goes in and each player's own card is kept inside the fourball. The session decides whether a hole is won on the better net score or on Stableford points.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
